help.short: Name of the Azure Front Door Standard or Azure Front Door Premium or CDN profile which is unique within the resource group.

confirmation: Are you sure you want to perform this operation?
description: Delete an existing  Azure Front Door Standard or Azure Front Door Premium or CDN profile with the specified parameters. Deleting a profile will result in the deletion of all of the sub-resources including endpoints, origins and custom domains.

operations.description: Deletes an existing  Azure Front Door Standard or Azure Front Door Premium or CDN profile with the specified parameters. Deleting a profile will result in the deletion of all of the sub-resources including endpoints, origins and custom domains.

params.description: Name of the Azure Front Door Standard or Azure Front Door Premium or CDN profile which is unique within the resource group.
params.name: profileName

params.description: The name of the resource group. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription. The value must be an UUID.
